intro.text: A young Elantrian who stands guard with a spear on the edge of New Elantris.

items.text: Taken by the Shaod while still young, Dion joined Raoden's guard under Captain Saolin and kept armed watch on the borders of New Elantris.

appearance.text: Blotchy-skinned and balding like other Elantrians, but young enough that he still looks fairly sturdy.
